$between.description: Checks whether a number is between two values (inclusive).

$clamp.description: Clamps a number between a minimum and maximum value.

$scaleNumber.description: Scales a number from one range to another.

$bitAnd.description: Performs a bitwise AND operation on two integers.

$bitNot.description: Performs a bitwise NOT operation on an integer.

$bitOr.description: Performs a bitwise OR operation on two integers.

$bitXor.description: Performs a bitwise XOR operation on two integers.

$hasFlag.description: Checks whether a bit flag is set.

$shiftLeft.description: Shifts bits to the left by a given amount.

$shiftRight.description: Shifts bits to the right (signed by default).

unsigned.description: Set to true for unsigned shift.

$acos.description: Calculates the inverse cosine (radians by default).

asDeg.description: Set to true to return degrees.

$asin.description: Calculates the inverse sine (radians by default).

asDeg.description: Set to true to return degrees.

$atan.description: Calculates the inverse tangent (radians by default).

x.description: Value to find inverse tangent of.

asDeg.description: Set to true to return degrees.

$atan2.description: Calculates the angle from Y and X coordinates (radians by default).

asDeg.description: Set to true to return degrees.

$factorial.description: Returns the factorial of an integer (n!).

$gcd.description: Returns the greatest common divisor of two integers.

$lcm.description: Returns the least common multiple of two integers.

$reciprocal.description: Returns the reciprocal of a number (1/x).

$ap.description: Calculates nth term of the arithmetic progression.

difference.description: The common difference between two terms.

n.description: The n to find nth term.

$gp.description: Calculates nth term of the geometric progression.

ratio.description: The common ratio between two terms.

n.description: The n to find nth term.

$hp.description: Calculates nth term of the harmonic progression.

difference.description: The common difference between two terms.

n.description: The n to find nth term.

$sumAp.description: Calculates the sum of n terms of the arithmetic progression.

difference.description: The common difference between two terms.

$sumGp.description: Calculates the sum of n terms of the geometric progression.

ratio.description: The common ratio between two terms.

$sumHp.description: Calculates the sum of n terms of the harmonic progression.

difference.description: The common difference between two terms.

$cos.description: Calculates the cosine of an angle (radians by default).

asDeg.description: Set to true if the angle is in degrees.

$sin.description: Calculates the sine of an angle (radians by default).

asDeg.description: Set to true if the angle is in degrees.

$tan.description: Calculates the tangent of an angle (radians by default).

asDeg.description: Set to true if the angle is in degrees.

$vecAdd.description: Adds multiple vectors and stores the result.

$vecAngle.description: Returns the angle between two vectors in radians.

$vecCross.description: Computes cross product of two 3D vectors.

$vecDot.description: Returns the dot product of two vectors.

$vecMag.description: Returns the magnitude (length) of a vector.

$vecNormalize.description: Normalizes a vector and stores the result.

$vecScale.description: Scales a vector by a scalar and stores the result.

$vecSub.description: Subtracts vectors sequentially and stores the result.

$vector.description: Returns the values of a vector.
